prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Houston, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1305; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in on a street in Houston, Texas. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: Yes, it's the name on my policy, and I'd rather keep the rest of my personal details off the recording unless you need them.

Q: That's understood. Can you describe what you were doing right before the collision?

A: I was driving home from work. It was a weekday evening, and traffic had slowed down in the lane ahead of me, so I was moving at maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour.

Q: Which direction were you traveling, and what happened next?

A: I was heading north. The other vehicle came over into my lane, and we met nearly head-on. It wasn't a hard hit, but both cars stopped right there.

Q: Were you able to get out of your vehicle on your own?

A: Yes, I got out. I felt shaken up, and my neck was stiff almost immediately. By the time the officer arrived, my lower back was also aching.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same night. They diagnosed me with a neck strain and a lower back strain. I was told to rest, take anti-inflammatories, and come back if things got worse.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limitations as a result?

A: Yes. Turning my head to check mirrors is uncomfortable, and I've had trouble sitting for long periods at work. I've been doing gentle stretching the physical therapist recommended.

Q: Did you have any pain or stiffness in those areas before this collision?

A: No, not to any significant degree. I had no ongoing treatment for either area before this happened.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want my vehicle damage and medical bills handled promptly, since I've been missing work and keeping up with appointments.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
